notes.title: “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Announced, COMING IN 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948498/d9cd52cae741b78d81f6fc7a009d13a9da7bdeb4.jpg[/img]
An alchemy RPG “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” is to be released in 2025. 

This title is the definitive edition of the Atelier "Secret" series, with brand new content such as additional playable characters and story from “Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout” to “Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key.”

Furthermore, a release date announcement program of “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe pack” has been scheduled for 4th August 2025 at 9pm JST (1pm BST / 2pm CEST). This program will reveal further details and new footage about the game.

“Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Teaser Site
https://atelier.games/secretdx/us/

notes.title: Atelier Ryza 5th Anniversary! "Secret" series optimization update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948498/9ea9b27c9aa7b54839302266cbf07c63d935b95d.png[/img]
To celebrate five years since the release of Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout, we have released various optimization updates for the “Secret” series!

[h3]■Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout[/h3]
Note: "Ver. 1.09" will be displayed on the SteamⓇ version's title screen.
- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Changed the keyboard and mouse control settings in the SteamⓇ version.
- Added an auto-save feature.
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added an option to fast forward event scenes.
- Added an option to auto-play text during event scenes.
- Added graphics settings to the Options menu.
- Made other minor adjustments.

Update on September 20th (FRI) 8 PM JST
*The title screen of the SteamⓇ version will display Ver. 1.10.
Fixed a bug where some option settings were not saved after applying update Ver. 1.09.
*After applying updates from Ver. 1.09, all option settings will be reset only during the first launch of the game

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121560/

[h3]■Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy[/h3]
Note: "Ver. 1.07" will be displayed on the SteamⓇ version's title screen.
- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Changed the keyboard and mouse control settings in the SteamⓇ version.
- Added the difficulty "Very Easy".
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added an option to fast forward event scenes.
- Adjusted the auto-play speed of text during event scenes.
- Added graphics settings to the Options menu.
- Made other minor adjustments.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257290/

[h3]■Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key[/h3]
Ver.1.7.0.0 (SteamⓇ)
Note: This will be displayed as Ver. 1.07 on the title screen.
- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Added the difficulty "Very Easy".
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added a new landmark: Kala's Tent
Note: Kala's Tent will be added as a landmark after visiting it once this update has been applied.
- Changed the completion requirements for Klaudia's "Three Medicines" character quest.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999770/

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.6.0.0 (2023/8/24)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue in the DLC expansion "Rosca Island" where the target monsters in the "Dian's Fighting Spirit" quest did not appear in some cases.
- Fixed an issue in the DLC expansion "Rosca Island" where it was sometimes impossible to complete the "Collecting Texts 3" quest even after reading all of the texts.
- Fixed an issue that caused the item's quality to drop through Item Rebuilding or Duplication under certain circumstances after applying the DLC expansion "Rosca Island" and learning the Max Efficiency skill.
- Fixed some English translations.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.5.0.0 (2023/6/22)
notes.notes:
- Improved the Graphics Settings option so that the depth of field can be set to High, Normal, Low, or Off.
- Improved readability of English texts.
- Fixed an issue where mouse and keyboard controls did not respond under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to stop responding when using Dian's Fatal Drive under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash right before transitioning to the Battle Results screen under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue where the "Creating Prototypes" quest failed to occur under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue in the "A Special Gift from Hometown" quest that made it impossible to deliver the requested item to the client under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue in which the descriptions of some skills, item effects, and traits differed from their actual specifications.
- Fixed an issue where certain items could not properly receive the effects displayed on the Guide.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to exit the Item Rebuilding screen under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue that caused the music to not play correctly during certain battles in some cases.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.4.0.0 (2023/6/1)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where quest details and objectives would not be displayed correctly on the quest screen when more than a certain number of quests were accepted, as well as quest indicators not working properly on the map.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to complete the "Where Did That Energy Go" quest under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue in the "Follow the Leading Bird" quest that caused the game to stop responding in some cases.
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to stop responding when a specific operation was performed on a specific screen.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to synthesize the Iridescent High-Purity Mucus under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to transfer a Super Trait to the Waking Emerald.
- Fixed an issue where some of the adventure effects applied to the Secret Key did not work properly.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Последнее приключение малышки Ризы: Обзор Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key
notes.notes: Серия Atelier смогла добиться всемирного признания и хороших тиражей именно с появлением приключений Ризы. Шаблонная для JRPG-франшизы история про девочек-волшебниц окончательно избавилась от всех проблем предшественников, начиная от заданий на время и заканчивая сложной алхимией и совершенно скучными сражениями. Конечно, до этого мы знакомились с милашкой Софи, но именно линейка про Ризу сделала то, чего не смогли сделать все вышедшие до неё 20 частей – порадовала создателей почти 2 миллионами проданных копий. Стартовавшая в конце марта этого года Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key закрывает великолепную трилогию, возвращая полюбившихся персонажей, и куда внимательнее, на фоне второй части, относится к проработке главных героев.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.3.0.0 (2023/4/27)
notes.notes:
- Additional Maximum Difficulty Patch.
- Added an option to change in-game BGM.
This function can be accessed through the Diary in any atelier and allows the player to change the BGM that plays at specific scenes during the game.
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from unlocking the "Your own answer" achievement after completing Patricia's quest in a specific order.
- Fixed an issue where Klaudia's "Klaudia, the Artist" quest failed to occur under certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue where it was sometimes impossible to continue the "The Underworld Forest" quest after being defeated in a battle against the Deranged King.
- Fixed an issue where, regardless of the gathering level or tools equipped, a “key” symbol is displayed on gathering points signifying that gathering requirements are not met.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.2.1.0 (2023/4/3)
notes.notes:
- Adjustment of the depth of field for the overall game.
- Adjusted the button input response time when connecting a normal attack to a skill attack during combat.
- Fixed an issue that occasionally caused the surface of the water to disappear.
- Fixed an issue where some key icons were not displayed correctly when using a 4K monitor.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.2.0.0 (2023/4/3)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue in the world quest "Deep into the Forest" in which the item required to progress the quest were sometimes not placed on the desk, even after examining three bookshelves.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.1.0.0 (2023/3/30)
notes.notes:
■Regarding the strong depth of field (DOF) in the game.

We are working on the issue of strong depth of field (DOF) in the game separately from the update on 3/30. We appreciate your patience.


- Added special photo mode update.
- Added Weasel Roast, Lamb Roast, & Devil Roast.
- Fixed an issue in which certain quests to deliver equipment, items, or gathering tools did not count as completed when the tool or equipment was unequipped before being delivered.
- Fixed an issue in the “The Recipe Sleeps at the Old Fairystone Silo” quest that made it impossible to access the door after a battle.
- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to climb some waterfalls with the Water Beast in the Cleria region.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Regarding the various feedback and measures to be taken
notes.notes:
Thank you for purchasing "Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key."
We have investigated issues raised by you, and have considered how to resolve them.
We are making every effort to ensure that everyone will be able to play more comfortably, and will make further announcements as soon as supporting date is determined.


[b]【Scheduled for early fixes】[/b]
[b]1. Regarding the strong depth of field (DOF) in the game.[/b]

[b]●Adjustment of the depth of field for the overall game.[/b]

The depth of field of the entire game has been reviewed and will be adjusted to make it more playable. 
Please note that this adjustment will result in a weaker depth of field for the game as a whole.


[b]【To be supported sequentially】[/b]
[b]2: Upcoming Updates [/b]

[b]●Expanded depth of field settings in the graphics options[/b]

The depth of field setting currently implemented in the SteamⓇ version has two levels: ON and OFF.
We will revise the settings to enable more detailed settings.
We would appreciate your patience as it will take some time to make this adjustment.
